method: Actual UI creates a classroom, saves a learner summary, starts a ten-question homework practice, selects observed A options, submits, links the committed round and explicitly confirms completion. Public lesson API and exact disk record checked before and after browser reload and owned Host cold restart.
limits: This concrete classroom opts out of mandatory wrong-answer reflections; default required-reflection completion is not certified by this browser run.
The all-A answers are explicit isolated acceptance inputs, not the user's actual learning performance or evidence of mastery.
No teacher model call or completed teaching transcript; real coaching, streaming, permission and Stop remain separate open gates.
Raw original questions, answers, lesson IDs, private source files and screenshots are excluded from remote delivery.
This proves classroom record persistence for the tested workflow; arbitrary migration and the complete original release scope remain unverified.
